from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,threading,hashlib,datetime
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');old=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark')
archives={'control':s/'candidate-sync-v29','candidate':s/'candidate-sync-v29'}
experiments=[('verification',1,0),('cache',2,0),('outer',4,0),('guard',0,1)]
schedule=[dict(experiment=label,mask=mask,omit=omit,batch=batch,route=route,build=build)for label,mask,omit in experiments for batch in range(2)for route,order in [('sky',['control','candidate']),('combat',['candidate','control']),('standard',['control','candidate']),('long',['candidate','control'])]for build in (order if batch==0 else order[::-1])]
plan=s/'hotpath-v29-timing-plan.json';assert not plan.exists()
assert json.loads((s/'v29-all-accepted.json').read_text())['accepted']
plan.write_text(json.dumps({'schedule':schedule,'fixed_before_first_sample':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'purpose':'64 serial observations, four independent switches, four routes, reversed orders. Same frozen binary, faster shared policy and original limits; no coverage-only options. All samples retained. Useful combination chosen only after individual panels. No owned correctness/build/census/profile work during timing.','archives':{k:{'path':str(v),'wasm_sha256':hashlib.sha256((v/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'provenance':json.loads((v/'provenance.json').read_text())}for k,v in archives.items()}},indent=2))
base={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items()if not k.startswith('EKA2L1_')}
base.update(EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_GPU='hardware',EKA2L1_PROFILE_DETAIL='0')
rows=[]
for index,job in enumerate(schedule):
 route=job['route'];build=job['build'];name=f'hotpath-v29-{index:02d}-{job["experiment"]}-{route}-{build}'
 env=dict(base,EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(archives[build]),EKA2L1_HOTPATH=str(job['mask'] if build=='candidate' else 0),EKA2L1_OMIT_GUARD_PUBLICATION=str(job['omit'] if build=='candidate' else 0))
 if build!='live':
  env.update(EKA2L1_THUMB_MEMORY='1',EKA2L1_ARM_MEMORY='0',EKA2L1_ROM_LEAVES='0',EKA2L1_ROM_CALLS='0',EKA2L1_ARM_EXCLUSIVE='0',EKA2L1_COMPILED_SVC='0',EKA2L1_COMPILED_MEMORY_MISSES='0',EKA2L1_SYNCHRONOUS_COMPILATION='0',EKA2L1_ROM_DISPATCH='0')
 if route in ('sky','combat'):
  assets=s/'assets';start=28000000 if route=='sky'else 42000000;end=start+6000000
  inp=r/('src/tests/benchmark/sky-force.input'if route=='sky'else'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force-combat.input')
  env.update(EKA2L1_APP_UID='0xa020d913',EKA2L1_ASSET_MANIFEST=str(r/'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force-assets.json'))
 else:
  assets=old/'assets';start=21000000 if route=='standard'else 42000000;end=start+18000000
  inp=r/('src/tests/benchmark/snakes.input'if route=='standard'else'src/tests/benchmark/snakes-length-long.input')
 env.update(EKA2L1_PROFILE_START_US=str(start),EKA2L1_PROFILE_INPUT=str(inp))
 args=['node','profile.ts',str(assets),str(s/name),'1','0',str(end)]
 meta=dict(job,index=index,name=name,started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),command=args,env={k:v for k,v in env.items()if k.startswith('EKA2L1_')},git_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r,text=True).strip())
 (s/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2));stop=threading.Event()
 def observer():
  with(s/(name+'-host.jsonl')).open('w')as f:
   while not stop.is_set():
    f.write(json.dumps({'utc':time.time(),'loadavg':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'cpu':Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines()[0],'temps':{str(p):p.read_text().strip()for p in Path('/sys/class/thermal').glob('thermal_zone*/temp')}})+'\n');f.flush();stop.wait(2)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=observer);thread.start();print(name+' START',flush=True);began=time.monotonic()
 try:
  with(s/(name+'.log')).open('w')as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 finally:stop.set();thread.join()
 report=json.loads((s/name/'report.json').read_text());m=report['measurement']
 assert report['unsafe_code']==3 and not report['sampling'] and report['shared_audio'] and not m['detailed'] and 'NVIDIA'in report['renderer']
 assert report['wasm_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((archives[build]/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if build=='live':assert report['thumb_memory']==-1 and report['rom_dispatch'] is None
 else:
  assert report['thumb_memory']==1 and report['rom_dispatch']==0
  assert report['hotpath_policy']==int(env['EKA2L1_HOTPATH']) and report['omit_guard_publication']==int(env['EKA2L1_OMIT_GUARD_PUBLICATION'])
  for key in ['arm_memory','rom_leaves','rom_calls','arm_exclusive','compiled_svc','compiled_memory_misses','synchronous_compilation']:assert report[key]==0
 row=dict(meta,command_seconds=time.monotonic()-began,wall_seconds=m['wall_seconds'],guest_seconds=(m['last_virtual_us']-m['first_virtual_us'])/1e6,instructions=m['last_instructions']-m['first_instructions'],presentations=m['presentations'],warmup_seconds=report['warmup_seconds'],runtime_footprint=report['runtime_footprint'])
 rows.append(row);(s/'hotpath-v29-timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(name+' PASS '+str(row['wall_seconds']),flush=True)
for route in ['sky','combat','standard','long']:
 selected=[q for q in rows if q['route']==route]
 assert len({q['instructions']for q in selected})==1 and len({q['presentations']for q in selected})==1
(s/'hotpath-v29-timing-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed':len(rows)}))

last=json.loads((s/(name+'-host.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()[-1])['utc']
resumed=time.time()
with(s/(name+'-host.jsonl')).open('a')as f:
 while True:
  stat=Path(f'/proc/{node}/stat').read_text().split(') ')[1].split()[0]
  if stat=='Z':break
  f.write(json.dumps({'utc':time.time(),'loadavg':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'cpu':Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines()[0],'temps':{str(p):p.read_text().strip()for p in Path('/sys/class/thermal').glob('thermal_zone*/temp')},'observer':'boundary-finalizer'})+'\n');f.flush();time.sleep(2)
ended=time.time();report=json.loads((s/name/'report.json').read_text());m=report['measurement'];meta=json.loads((s/(name+'-command.json')).read_text())
assert report['hotpath_policy']==2 and report['omit_guard_publication']==0 and report['unsafe_code']==3 and report['rom_dispatch']==0 and not m['detailed'] and not report['sampling']
assert report['wasm_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((s/'candidate-sync-v29/eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
row=dict(meta,command_seconds=None,command_seconds_note='Coordinator suspended at user-directed boundary change. Its monotonic start was not recoverable; do not invent whole-command duration. Runtime-measured warmup and gameplay clocks remain intact.',wall_seconds=m['wall_seconds'],guest_seconds=(m['last_virtual_us']-m['first_virtual_us'])/1e6,instructions=m['last_instructions']-m['first_instructions'],presentations=m['presentations'],warmup_seconds=report['warmup_seconds'],runtime_footprint=report['runtime_footprint'],observer_gap_seconds=resumed-last)
rows=json.loads((s/'hotpath-v29-timings.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==17 and row['index']==17
assert row['instructions']==rows[-1]['instructions'] and row['presentations']==rows[-1]['presentations']
rows.append(row);(s/'hotpath-v29-timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
(s/'hotpath-v29-partial.json').write_text(json.dumps({'complete':False,'completed_observations':18,'planned_observations':64,'reason':'User-directed workflow change at 2026-10-03T00:10:48Z: finish current observation, retain results, revise remaining plan prospectively.
